Need to reshape FP8 QKV projections scales in the same way that weights are reshaped * Allow remaining FP8 tensors to be dequantized during conversion * Allow tensor-strategy for FP8-only compressed-tensor ckpts * Fix and test gguf-py behavior for FP8_E4M3 * Disallow QKV-fusion for FP8 temporarily * Fix conversion of fused qkvz & FP8 for Qwen3-Next * Avoid fusing FP8 for --fuse-gate-up-exps as we may have different ws * Emit warnings when not fusing FP8 during conversion * More FP8 conversion fixes * Add supported for strided copies to/from FP8 in CPU * remove unneeded scratch buffer from FP8 cpu cpy/dup path * add explanatory comments and TODOs * Add dedicated encoder and decoder tests for FP8 * Whitelist ggml_op_get_rows in metal instead of blacklisting Fix more conversion bugs * Defer weight materialization during conversion * Blacklist fp8 in metal backend instead of white-list * Adjust indents * Fix lint + execute tests * Add fast CPU kernel for F8_E4M3 * Conversion fixes * Fix remaining gaps * Enable tied weights with shared scales * Make mandatory-F32 rules apply to FP8 during conversion * Fix python type checks The kernel no longer uses threadgroup memory. * metal : launch contiguous unary and binary ops with full threadgroups The contiguous unary path and the row-broadcast binary path used one thread per threadgroup. Use up to 256 threads per threadgroup and bound-check the tail. * metal : split GLU rows across threadgroups A GLU row ran on one threadgroup, so single-row decode used a single threadgroup for the whole op.
